scope: Source-only X-M1 1.50 queue-36 event-6 controller translation; no build, native execution, SDK or camera qualification

selection.executor: 0x00d80dd8 reads stride 12 from 0x00d834d4 and table 0x00d834d8 through pointer 0x00d840a8; entry address is table + 12 * (event * stride + state)
selection.evidence_kind: Actual raw-image table and A32 control flow inspected. Names did not select entries.

providers.primary_cleanup: 0x00d81cdc is the actual address of donor-named FUN_010af8b4; Power unregister_primary releases 0x0146a09c and clears primary activity
providers.secondary_cleanup: 0x00d81e94 is the actual address of donor-named FUN_010afa6c; Power unregister_secondary handles mode 2 cancellation status -11 and registry release
providers.transfer_cleanup: 0x00d820a8 cancels 0x0146a0b8 and 0x0146a0bc only for kind 2, then calls table 0x00d97fb0 slot 2, actual 0x00d95498; that leaf clears bytes 0x0146af98 and 0x0146af9b
providers.file_close: 0x00d917e0 returns table 0x00d91f70; slot 3 is actual 0x00d8d5b0, a raw-inspected unranged leaf setting word 0x0146a644 to one
providers.transport: ControllerTeardown is provided by ProtocolTransportClosure, not a retained software callback
providers.completion_consumer: 0x00ecc228 loads 0x00ecfe64 and calls 0x00d82394, which registers field +0x414. Actual 0x00ecfe64 posts queue 7 command 0x1714 and an eight-byte little-endian handle/status payload
providers.request_consumer: 0x00ecc104, 0x00ecd1ac and 0x00ecd38c register actual 0x00ecfeb0 through 0x00d82478 with handles 3, 2 and 4. That consumer posts queue 7 command 0xb403 and an eight-byte little-endian handle/status payload
providers.secondary_cancel_consumer: Request 2 table 0x00ed0444 slot +0x10 is actual 0x00ed0920, which posts queue 7 command 0x171a and a four-byte signed status. Request 4 table 0x00ed0488 slot +0x10 is null. Power NativeUsbRegistrations must select the owned secondary_status_consumer for request 2 and no completion for request 4.
providers.closed_consumer: Power usb_release_acknowledged owns actual 0x00ecfe20, posting queue 7 command 0xb401. Status publication precedes this post.

raw_identities.range_status: unranged; converged leaf extent ends at 0x00d8d5d4

integration.dependency: //replacement/power_lifecycle:power-lifecycle-rust, crate xm1_power_lifecycle; transport's owned scheduler and teardown sources
integration.service_join: controller_root::ControllerRoot::step executes each queue-36 cell. QueueController::consume_completion and shutdown return Deferred without storing; ControllerRuntime::completion and the root queue the message in DeferredMessages. ShutdownResources carries the registration storage, registry, teardown platform, scheduler Machine, ShutdownRtos, the ProtocolFiles abort (0x00d8d5b0) and the PictBridge transfer flags.
integration.remaining_boundary: Service/lib/BUILD joins are integration-owner work. Queue publication is through the actual owned Power RTOS API, not installed firmware execution. Event6 debug application routing is separate from USB controller event index 6.
